response.sql: WITH group_stats AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile, AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_modindex, AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshift FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile), mean_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS baseline_modindex FROM group_stats), kept_groups AS (SELECT gs.telescregistry, gs.weathprofile, gs.avg_modindex, gs.avg_phaseshift, mam.baseline_modindex FROM group_stats gs CROSS JOIN mean_baseline mam WHERE gs.avg_modindex > mam.baseline_modindex) SELECT weathprofile, AVG(avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex_for_weather, AVG(avg_phaseshift) AS avg_phaseshift_for_weather, AVG(avg_modindex - baseline_modindex) AS avg_excess_modindex FROM kept_groups GROUP BY weathprofile ORDER BY weathprofile;
